info.text:
The Fed's favorite inflation gauge just hit 3.8%.
October PCE inflation: 3.8% a year, nearly double the Fed's 2% goal.
Core PCE: 3.3%, above the 3.2% economists expected.
Q3 GDP was revised up to 4.3% from 3.4%.
Markets see a Fed rate hike at the Dec 8-9 meeting as close to certain.
Sources: BEA (Nov 25, 2026), CNBC, Morningstar, CME FedWatch.
News and education, not financial advice.
